ocl:
context Exam
inv: (self.offering.course.credits <= 50) and (self.type.size() >= 4 implies self.type.substring(1, 4) = 'AB')

context Exam
inv: ((self.attempts->one(x | x.marks > 2)) and (self.offering.oclIsTypeOf(CourseOffering))) and (self.attempts->size() = 2)

context Scholarship
inv: (if self.startYear > self.endYear then self.startYear else self.endYear endif > 11) and (self.endYear mod 2 = 1)

context CourseOffering
inv: self.capacity >= 2 and self.capacity <= 65

context CourseOffering
inv: self.exams->size() >= 2 and self.exams->size() <= 2

context Course
inv: (self.credits mod 2 = 0) and (self.code <> '' and self.code.size() > 0)

context Semester
inv: self.endDate <> null and self.startDate <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.startYear <> null implies self.endYear <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.endYear <> null implies self.startYear <> null

context Semester
inv: self.startDate <> null and self.endDate <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.startYear <> null and self.endYear <> null

context Scholarship
inv: self.endYear <> null and self.startYear <> null

context CourseOffering
inv: (self.enrollments->any(x | x.enrolledAt <> '') <> null) and (self.instructor.oclIsTypeOf(Instructor))

context Scholarship
inv: (self.endYear + self.startYear > 73) and (self.endYear + self.startYear > 64)

context CourseOffering
inv: ((self.exams->size() > 0) and (self.room.oclIsTypeOf(Room))) and (self.capacity mod 2 = 0)

context Semester
inv: (self.offerings->exists(x | x.capacity > 1)) and (not(self.offerings->exists(x | x.capacity > 1)))

context Room
inv: ((self.building.university.name <> '') and (self.capacity mod 2 = 0)) and (not((self.building.university.name <> '') and (self.capacity mod 2 = 0)))

context CourseOffering
inv: ((self.exams->any(x | x.maxMarks > 0) <> null) and (self.exams->collect(x | x.attempts)->flatten()->notEmpty())) and (not((self.exams->any(x | x.maxMarks > 0) <> null) and (self.exams->collect(x | x.attempts)->flatten()->notEmpty())))

context Student
inv: (self.libraryAccount <> null) and (not(self.libraryAccount <> null))

context Department
inv: (self.courses->exists(x | x.credits <= 100)) and (not(self.courses->exists(x | x.credits <= 100)))

context Scholarship
inv: (self.startYear <> self.endYear) and (not(self.startYear <> self.endYear))

context Scholarship
inv: (self.endYear + self.startYear > 71) and (not(self.endYear + self.startYear > 71))

context Building
inv: ((self.rooms->size() > 0) and (self.rooms->one(x | x.capacity < 10))) and (self.rooms->size() < -5)

context Instructor
inv: ((self.department.faculty.name <> '') and (self.email.size() >= 4 implies self.email.substring(1, 4) = 'AB')) and (not((self.department.faculty.name <> '') and (self.email.size() >= 4 implies self.email.substring(1, 4) = 'AB')))

context CourseOffering
inv: (self.enrollments->exists(x | x.enrolledAt <> '')) and (not(self.enrollments->exists(x | x.enrolledAt <> '')))

context Building
inv: ((self.university.code <> '') and (self.code.size() = 19)) and (not((self.university.code <> '') and (self.code.size() = 19)))

context Course
inv: ((self.offerings->collect(x | x.capacity)->notEmpty()) and (self.offerings->size() <= 1)) and (self.offerings->size() > 1)

context Course
inv: ((self.credits < 50) and (self.offerings->forAll(v | v.capacity <= 50))) and (self.credits > 55)

context Course
inv: (self.offerings->forAll(x | x.capacity <= 100)) and (self.offerings->exists(x | not(x.capacity <= 100)))

context Room
inv: ((self.capacity <= 100) and (self.offerings->forAll(v | v.capacity <= 1000))) and (self.capacity > 100)
